_comment: Registry of every real image or video asset depicting an animal or person, reviewed against scripts/data/compliance-policy.json halal.animate_imagery. The compliance gate (scripts/compliance/halal.mjs) reads this file for every media asset it finds in a composition: no entry means blocked, exactly like an unrecorded audio track is already blocked under legal.require_audio_licence_record in audio-licences.json. Nothing here is inferred from a filename by the gate; every entry is a human judgement call recorded once and reused.
_policy: Narrowed 1 Sep 2026, approved by the channel owner in chat: real imagery of animals is permitted, real imagery of people is not, and every asset must be confirmed free of eyes and faces in every frame before it can be marked cleared. See scripts/data/compliance-policy.json halal.animate_imagery and scripts/data/VISUAL-DIRECTION-BRIEF.md for the full history.

assets.review_method: Byte-identical copy of assets/bg/mantis-shrimp-colour-demo.mp4 (same sha, same 7495299 bytes), placed under public/bg/ solely so Remotion's staticFile() can serve it into the actual composition; Remotion's public dir is public/, not assets/, so the file has to live here to be rendered at all. No new review performed on this copy: it is pixel-identical to the entry below, which was reviewed by extracting and viewing frames at 0.05s, 2.5s and 4.95s across the source clip.
assets.notes: This is the path that actually appears in rendered props (scripts/data/topics-rich.json, mantis-shrimp-colour topic, the opening media beat), and therefore the path scripts/compliance/halal.mjs will look up. Keep this entry and the assets/bg/ entry in sync: if the source crop is ever redone, redo this copy and re-verify both.

assets.review_method: Cropped from the original Flux 2.0 Pro generation to exclude the eye-stalks entirely (equivalent to crop=708:1258:222:789 on the source, scaled back to 1152x2048), then checked by viewing the resulting still directly, not by trusting the crop math alone.
assets.notes: Test/reference asset in assets/bg, not wired into generate-reels.mjs yet. The original eyed generation is kept on disk as mantis-shrimp-colour-demo.png.old-with-eyes for provenance, is not git-tracked, and is recorded separately below as not cleared.

assets.review_method: Cropped from the original Kling 2.5 Turbo Pro image-to-video generation with crop=664:1180:208:740 (source 1080x1920, scaled back to 1080x1920), then checked at three timestamps across the 5s clip (0.05s, 2.5s, 4.95s) by extracting and viewing each frame, since the clip has a slow camera drift that a single-frame check could miss.
assets.notes: Test/reference asset in assets/bg, not wired into generate-reels.mjs yet. The original eyed generation is kept on disk as mantis-shrimp-colour-demo.mp4.old-with-eyes for provenance, is not git-tracked, and is recorded separately below as not cleared.

assets.review_method: A still frame extracted at 2.5s from the already-cropped, already-cleared mantis-shrimp-colour-demo.mp4. No additional imagery, so the parent entry's review covers it; re-verified visually on extraction.
assets.notes: Kept so the crop result can be checked without opening a video player.

assets.review_method: ffmpeg composite of the already-cropped, already-cleared mantis-shrimp-colour-demo.mp4 with beat text (textfile= drawtext, repositioned to the bottom third after the crop removed the top-third negative space) and public/sounds/bbmw0-ocean-swell.mp3. No new imagery introduced by compositing text or audio, so the parent video's eyes/face review still applies; re-verified by extracting and viewing a frame plus a volumedetect pass on the audio.
assets.notes: Test/reference asset, not wired into generate-reels.mjs yet. Demonstrates real imagery, real beat text and real licensed audio together for this project's actual visual direction.
